title: A cancelled run's end still reads as done/0 from watch — latent, nothing writes that state today
description:
The reconciler never currently writes runstate.StateCancelled (it is vocabulary only), but the resume path's already-terminal branch writes run_finished "the run is already cancelled: …", and the new failed classifier deliberately classifies only the failed word — so a cancelled end exits 0 / state "done". If a future tick starts cancelling runs (a stop that must be distinguishable from completion, as 2jn's A4 asks for failed), the watch and the exit-table vocabulary need a decided answer for it; the overview already names it its own word.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 06b4a44130718e4ad5a1f7b83cc2db1cb2664b1ec9925e05e602cafca028f0f0 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-bot/attempt-39): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/06b4a44130718e4ad5a1f7b83cc2db1cb2664b1ec9925e05e602cafca028f0f0.json on the run branch.
